title: Message Queues for Async Processing
description: Use message queues (RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus) for async processing, load leveling, and decoupling services.

data.text: Message queues enable asynchronous processing, load leveling, and service decoupling. Producers send messages to queues, and consumers process them at their own pace.

cards.title: Work Queue
cards.description: Multiple consumers compete for messages. Good for parallel processing of independent tasks.

cards.title: Pub/Sub
cards.description: Messages broadcast to multiple subscribers. Good for fan-out scenarios like notifications.

cards.title: Dead Letter Queue
cards.description: Failed messages routed to DLQ for inspection and retry. Essential for reliability.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Message queues enable async processing and load leveling
Work queue pattern distributes work across consumers
Pub/Sub pattern broadcasts to multiple subscribers
Dead letter queues handle failed messages gracefully
Choose broker based on throughput, ordering, and durability requirements
data.takeaway: Message queues are essential for scalable, decoupled systems. Use them for async processing, load leveling, and event distribution. Handle failures with dead letter queues.
